test_title: PYST 70: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
The population of a town is 120,000, increasing 6% yearly.

Estimate the population after 5 years.
solution:
**Given:**

 
• Initial population = 1,20,000
 
• Annual increase = 6%
 
• Time = 5 years

**Formula:**

Final Population = P × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

Where P = 1,20,000, r = 6, n = 5

Using formula directly:

= 1,20,000 × (1.06)⁵

= 1,20,000 × 1.33823

= 1,60,587
